nodes.name: Japanese maple tree
nodes.caption: A small Japanese maple tree with vibrant red, deeply lobed leaves, planted in a weathered, rustic ceramic pot with visible glaze variations and subtle cracks; the pot sits on a mossy stone base, and the tree leans slightly toward the interior light.

nodes.name: tanuki figurine
nodes.caption: A ceramic tanuki (raccoon dog) figurine wearing a green leaf hat and white bib, seated cross-legged with a cheerful expression, holding a sake bottle in one paw and a coin pouch in the other; glossy glaze with earthy tones and fine detailing on facial features and clothing.

nodes.name: wooden tea crate
nodes.caption: A low, rectangular wooden crate with horizontal slats and visible grain, featuring two small drawer-like front panels with recessed handles; it holds a teapot and three matching teacups, all steaming gently, and rests on a moss-covered stone platform.

nodes.name: Japanese floor lamp
nodes.caption: A traditional Japanese floor lamp (andon) with a tall, rectangular wooden frame and translucent paper panels glowing warmly from an internal light source; the frame has vertical and horizontal joinery details and stands upright on the wooden veranda floor.

nodes.name: wooden veranda
nodes.caption: A raised wooden veranda (engawa) with dark-stained planks, extending from the house entrance; it supports the lamp and tea table, and is bordered by a low wooden railing and shoji screens in the background.

nodes.name: tea table
nodes.caption: A low, rectangular wooden tea table with a woven mat top (possibly rush or bamboo), supporting a tea set including a tray, teapot, and cups; the table has sturdy legs and sits on a stone-and-wood platform adjacent to the veranda.

nodes.name: moss-covered stone platform
nodes.caption: An irregularly shaped, moss-covered natural stone platform composed of layered flat rocks, forming a raised base for the figurine, crate, and tea table; surfaces are wet from rain, showing reflective highlights and patches of green moss.
